remarks: Built in 1785, this remarkable antique colonial has been thoughtfully expanded and renovated to today's standards. Spanning 5,662 square feet, the home features 5 bedrooms, 4 full and 2 half baths, 6 fireplaces, and high ceilings offering a refined balance of period craftsmanship and modern comfort. The kitchen boasts a custom wood ceiling, complemented by a large center island, soapstone countertops and top-of-the-line Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, making it ideal for culinary enthusiasts. Exposed beams frame the great room, while oversized windows and French doors invite natural light and extend the living area outdoors. Three finished levels include a spacious dining room, private bedroom suites, and other inviting living spaces. An expansive bluestone terrace with its outdoor fireplace overlooks a level acre, providing a perfect setting for dining and entertaining - a fitting backdrop to this storied North Stamford residence. Central air and a two-car garage add everyday convenience, along with easy access to the Merritt Parkway, shopping and downtown Stamford.
